title.zh: 小众机场与老牌机场技术底蕴对比：自建运维团队 vs 开源面板一键开站的抗风险差异
title.en: Established vs Niche Proxies: In-House DevOps Engineering vs One-Click Open-Source Panels

cluster.zh: 机场跑路前兆与稳定性监测集群

description.zh: 深入探讨拥有自研高防 BGP 调度、专属机房工程师团队的老牌专线机场，与使用开源 v2board 面板一键开站的“学生兼职作坊”在遭遇封锁、DDoS 攻击与机房故障时的抗风险代差。
description.en: Comparing established proxy operations staffed with dedicated DevOps engineers and multi-homed BGP hardware against amateur one-click v2board setups during DDoS and carrier outages.
